plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for DeltaNet Lambdatrail2-S optical transmission devices. It reports chassis ambient temperature, power-supply state, PSU fan state/speed, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 35616, lambdatrail2s 1.3.6.1.4.1.35616.5).
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Chassis ambient temperature of the DeltaNet Lambdatrail2-S in degrees Celsius, from lt2sTemperature (1.3.6.1.4.1.35616.5.2.1.0, Integer32 0-80). Values outside 0-80 and sentinel readings are dropped. The SNMP value is already in Celsius.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Power supply status of the DeltaNet Lambdatrail2-S from lt2sPowerStatus (1.3.6.1.4.1.35616.5.2.3.0). Mapped as normal(1)->1, failed(2)->2; notPlugged(3) and other codes are dropped.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: PSU fan status of the DeltaNet Lambdatrail2-S from lt2sPowerFanStatus (1.3.6.1.4.1.35616.5.2.4.0). Mapped as on(2)->1 (running), off(3)->0 (stopped, a configured state), failed(1)->2 (fault); other codes are dropped.

metrics.name: device_fan_speed
metrics.description: PSU fan rotation speed of the DeltaNet Lambdatrail2-S in RPM, from lt2sPowerFanRPM (1.3.6.1.4.1.35616.5.2.5.0, Integer32 0-20000). 0 is a real reading when the fan is off. Values outside 0-20000 and sentinel readings are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the DeltaNet Lambdatrail2-S since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime. Monitoring uptime helps administrators understand device stability and identify unexpected reboots.
